items.story: Oil prices rose as Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia increased tensions and led to US diplomatic withdrawals. Brent crude futures gained $1.29, while US West Texas Intermediate crude rose by 97 cents after the attacks. The US State Department has ordered the withdrawal of some family members from various missions in the region. There was a noticeable drop in US crude stocks last week, contrary to analysts' expectations.

items.story: Ascertis Credit Group has raised more than $700 million in commitments for its fourth private credit fund. items.story: ‘ചോദ്യംചോദിച്ചാൽ വിദേശ ഏജന്റാക്കരുത്’; CJP നേതാക്കളെ അറസ്റ്റുചെയ്തതിനെതിരേ അണ്ണാമലൈ; മറുപടിയുമായി BJP Mathrubhumi'ചോദ്യം ചെയ്താല്‍ വിദേശ ചാരന്‍?' ബിജെപിക്കെതിരെ അണ്ണാമലൈ Manorama Newsചോദ്യം ചെയ്യുന്നവർ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് 'വിദേശ ഏജന്റ്'; കേന്ദ്രത്തിനും ബിജെപിക്കുമെതിരെ അണ്ണാമലൈ Kerala Kaumudi'ആ ചോദ്യങ്ങൾക്ക് പിന്തുണ', സിജെപിയെ പിന്തുണച്ചും പോലീസിനെ വിമർശിച്ചും മുൻ ബിജെപി അധ്യക്ഷൻ അണ്ണാമലൈ Oneindia MalayalamCJP പ്രവർത്തകരുടെ അറസ്റ്റ്: വിമർശിച്ച് K അണ്ണാമലൈ, മറുപടി നൽകി BJP, രാഷ്ട്രീയ വാഗ്വാദങ്ങൾ ചൂടുപിടിക

items.teaser: Tiny underwater algae sway gently in the current. All of a sudden, a light shines on them and they form robotlike arms that start to pick…
items.story: Tiny underwater algae sway gently in the current. All of a sudden, a light shines on them and they form robotlike arms that start to pick up small rocks and put them in floating baskets. Sounds like science fiction, but researchers from Delft University of Technology (the Netherlands) have created a small soft robot arm covered with minuscule algae that can grasp and lift objects. And it's powered by light. This next step in biotechnology has been published in Nature Communications.

items.story: Giant manta rays can grow up to nine meters (30 feet) long with a disk size of seven meters (23 feet) across and weigh up to 2,000 kg (4,400 pounds). This size leaves them with very few natural enemies once they reach adulthood at around eight to 10 years old. But giant manta ray babies, called pups, cannot rely on their size to protect them from predators that live in the open ocean, including several species of shark and orcas.

items.story: బుమ్రా కాదు.. భువీ బౌలింగ్ అత్యంత ప్రమాదకరం: కివీస్ మాజీ క్రికెటర్ Andhrajyothyభారత ఫ్లాట్ పిచ్‌లపైనే స్వింగ్ చేస్తాడు.. మా పరిస్థితుల్లో భువీ మాకు పెద్ద సవాల్: మిచెల్ శాంట్నర్ AP7AMBhuvneshwar Kumar : న్యూజిలాండ్‌తో టీ20 సిరీస్‌.. భువ‌నేశ్వ‌ర్ కుమార్‌ను ఊరిస్తున్న భారీ మైలురాళ్లు.. 10TV TeluguBhuvneshwar Kumar Returns: నాలుగేళ్ల తర్వాత భువీ రీఎంట్రీ.. జట్టులోకి ఎందుకు తీసుకున్నారో చెప్పిన శ్రేయస్! NewsBytes Teluguన్యూజిలాండ్‌లో భువీకి పండగే.. అర్ష్‌దీప్‌కు అలెన్‌ చిక్కడం ఖాయమంటున్న మాజీ కోచ్‌!
